scope: Xbox Mod Workspace package-ready archive reconstruction

fixes.xbox_gz_sdat: Xbox .bin.gz.sdat paths are gzip-wrapped directly; they are not routed through the PS3 NPDRM/SDAT limitation
fixes.raw_sound_bin: raw .bin package paths remain raw BBX
fixes.single_deployment_tree: Xbox builds emit deployment copies only under build/xbox360_replacements and remove legacy game_patch/decompressed_bbx mirrors
fixes.stale_output_cleanup: xbox360_replacements is recreated for each build
fixes.workspace_path_repair: known Xbox retail wrapper paths lost by older updater-generated manifest.source values are repaired when a workspace loads
fixes.updater_provenance: future asset refreshes preserve the previous source label instead of substituting retained decompressed_bbx/*.bin

synthetic_regression.message_payload: verified BBX containing edited readable localization
